title: Parallel-Plate Transmission Line
text: Model parallel-plate transmission line, {Stub mode} sets Type of; {Plate width (m)} sets the width of parallel-plate transmission line, {Plate separation (m)} sets the dielectric spacing in parallel-plate transmission line, {Relative permeability constant} sets the relative permeability of the dielectric material in the parallel-plate transmission, {Relative permittivity constant} sets the relative permittivity of the dielectric material in the parallel-plate transmission, {Loss tangent of dielectric}, {Conductivity of the conductor (S/m)} sets the conductivity of conductor, {Transmission line length(m)} sets the physical length of the transmission line, {Termination of stub} sets the stub termination, {Source of frequency data} sets the frequency data source, {Frequency data (Hz)} sets the frequency data range, {Reference impedance (ohms)}, {Plot type} sets the type of data plot, {Y parameter1} sets the type of parameters, {Y parameter2} sets the type of parameters, {Y format1} plots format Magnitude, {Y format2} plots format Magnitude, {X parameter} sets the frequency plot, {X format} sets the frequency plot format, {Y scale} sets the y-axis scale, {X scale} sets the x-axis scale and {Plot}. Values come from the instance.
